info.title: PACE API
info.description: Automated documentary-style narrated video production API

post.summary:
POST /api/v1/admin/users
Creates a new user with a temporary password and quota. Requires admin role.

400.description: Validation error

patch.summary:
PATCH /api/v1/admin/users/{id}
Activates or deactivates a user. If deactivated, immediately terminates all active sessions (AUTH-04).

post.summary:
POST /api/v1/admin/users/{id}/reset-password
Resets a user's password to a temporary password, flags must_change_password = true,
and terminates all active sessions.

400.description: Validation error
Validation error

get.summary:
GET /api/v1/projects
Lists all active projects owned by the authenticated user (PRJ-02, AUTH-05).

200.description: List of user projects sorted by updated_at DESC

post.summary:
POST /api/v1/projects
Creates a new project for the authenticated user (PRJ-01, AUTH-05).

Location.description: URI of the newly created project

400.description: Validation error

ETag.description: Entity tag representing current project version

404.description: Project not found or owned by another user

delete.summary:
DELETE /api/v1/projects/{id}
Soft-deletes a project owned by the authenticated user (PRJ-06, AUTH-05).

get.summary:
GET /healthz
Liveness probe: returns 200 OK if the API server process is responding.

GET /readyz
Readiness probe: returns 200 OK if the database connection pool is healthy.
Returns 503 Service Unavailable if the database is unreachable.

crossfade_ms.description: Crossfade duration between loops in milliseconds (`0..=5000`).

ducking_enabled.description: Automatically duck music under narration speech.

fade_in_ms.description: Fade-in duration at the start of the video in milliseconds (`0..=15000`).

fade_out_ms.description: Fade-out duration at the end of the video in milliseconds (`0..=15000`).

loop_enabled.description: Loop music track to fill the entire video duration.

volume_db.description: Background music volume in dB (`-40.0` to `0.0`).

ProblemDetails.description:
RFC 9457 Problem Details payload.
Returned for all 4xx and 5xx API errors with Content-Type: application/problem+json.

split_word_index.description: Optional word index (`1..word_count`) or split time to split at; defaults to midpoint.
